description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Dragoon Pride], [Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Soaring Knight Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dragoon Pride
description.text: Dragoon abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dragoon abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Soaring Knight Mode
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient), keeps track of the number of Lightning and Dark abilities used (0~4), grants [Soaring Knight Critical Chance] after using a Lightning or Dark ability
